scanNote:
15-UNITNING OLTINChI (OXIRGI) BETI (109-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda YaShIL yorliqda oq '15', chapida 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP USTUN:
19) 'GAME: Ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: You are ......, aren't you? SB: Yes/No, ...... . SA: You come from ......, don't you? SB: Yes/No, ...... . SA: You like/don't like ......, don't you?/do you? SB: Yes/No, ...... . SA: You've got ......, haven't you? SB: Yes/No, ...... .
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
20) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: 'surf the net, e-mail address, exist, join a newsgroup, visit a web site, 'chat' friends, download a document, save time, in search of, current events, without doubt, can be solved'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing (a for-and-against essay)'.
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: 'When we write A FOR-AND-AGAINST ESSAY we can divide it into four paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we STATE THE TOPIC. In the SECOND PARAGRAPH we write THE POINTS FOR, explaining each point. In the THIRD PARAGRAPH we write THE POINTS AGAINST, in the same way. In the FOURTH PARAGRAPH, we SUM UP the topic and GIVE OUR OPINION. We use PRESENT TENSES in such pieces of writing. We can also use words such as: ALSO, HOWEVER, ON THE OTHER HAND, FIRSTLY, etc to list our points.'
21) Kasseta belgisi: a) qiya 'Should children use the Internet?' 'Read the points (1-6) and mark them as P (pros) or C (cons). Then, listen and check your answers.'

O'NG USTUN:
   KO'K QUTI 'Children on the Net: yes or no?' (surat: kompyuter oldida o'g'il va qiz): 1 The net is part of our world, so children need to use it. ...... 2 Many use it for playing games, not for learning. ...... 3 They learn about other countries and cultures. ...... 4 They can meet people from all over the world. ...... 5 Some web sites are not suitable for children. ...... 6 They can make friends in faraway places. ......
   b) 'Read the topic sentences. Which: states the topic and main viewpoints ☐; introduces points for ☐; introduces points against ☐; sums up the topic and gives an opinion ☐?' 1 On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own. 2 The Internet is a great learning tool for children, but what about the problems and dangers if children are allowed to surf the net on their own? 3 Many people are in favour of children using the Internet. 4 The Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised when they're using it, and parents must teach them how to use it properly.
   c) 'Use the points for and against, and the topic sentences above, to talk about the pros and cons of the Internet for children.'
22) 'Use the information from Ex. 21 and the plan below to write a for-and-against essay (120-180 words) about whether children should use the Internet. Use the text in Ex. 13 as a model.' SPIRAL DAFTAR 'Plan': Introduction - Para 1: state the topic. Main Body - Para 2: points for children using the Internet; Para 3: points against children using the Internet. Conclusion - Para 4: sum up the advantages & disadvantages.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom': 'Read the sentence. What does it mean?' Ramkada: • 'A little knowledge is a dangerous thing.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '109'.

exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Juftlikda savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. SA: Siz ..., shundaymi? SB: Ha/Yo'q, ... . SA: Siz ...dansiz, shundaymi? SB: Ha/Yo'q, ... . SA: Siz ...ni yoqtirasiz/yoqtirmaysiz, shundaymi? SB: Ha/Yo'q, ... . SA: Sizda ... bor, shundaymi? SB: Ha/Yo'q, ... .
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  ..., aren't you? → Yes, I am. /
    No, I'm not.
  ..., don't you? → Yes, I do. /
    No, I don't.
  ..., do you? → Yes, I do. / No,
    I don't.
  ..., haven't you? → Yes, I have.
    / No, I haven't.

  'You don't like fish, do you?' -
  yoqtirsangiz 'Yes, I do'; yoqtir-
  masangiz "No, I don't".

exercises.instructionUz: Jamoalarda quyidagi so'z/iboralardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap bir ochko oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
15-UNIT LUG'ATI - TAKRORLASh.

  surf the net = Internetda kezmoq
  e-mail address = e-mail manzili
  exist = mavjud bo'lmoq
  join a newsgroup = yangiliklar
    guruhiga qo'shilmoq
  visit a web site = saytga kirmoq
  'chat' friends = chat do'stlari
  download a document = hujjat
    yuklab olmoq

You can join a newsgroup about your hobby.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a for-and-against essay we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Tarafdor va qarshi insho yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
TARAFDOR VA QARShI INShO (4
XATBOShI):

  1 - MAVZUNI BAYoN QILISh
  2 - TARAFDOR FIKRLAR (har birini
      tushuntirib)
  3 - QARShI FIKRLAR (xuddi shunday)
  4 - UMUMLAShTIRISh + FIKRIMIZ

  ⚠ ZAMON: hozirgi zamonlar.
  ⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR: also, however,
  on the other hand, firstly.


⚠ FIKR MAQOLASIDAN FARQI:

  Fikr maqolasi (103-bet): fikr
  BOShIDA, oxirida qayta.
  Tarafdor-qarshi: ikki tomon TENG,
  fikr faqat OXIRIDA.


⚠ 'AN ESSAY':

  = insho.


⚠ 'POINTS FOR / AGAINST':

  = tarafdor / qarshi dalillar.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we state the topic.
In the second paragraph we write the points for, explaining each point. In the third paragraph we write the points against, in the same way.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida tarafdor fikrlarni har birini tushuntirib yozamiz. Uchinchi xatboshida qarshi fikrlarni xuddi shunday yozamiz.

points.en: In the fourth paragraph, we sum up the topic and give our opinion.
points.uz: To'rtinchi xatboshida mavzuni umumlashtiramiz va fikrimizni beramiz.

points.en: We use present tenses in such pieces of writing. We can also use words such as: also, however, on the other hand, firstly, etc to list our points.
points.uz: Bunday yozma ishlarda hozirgi zamonlarni ishlatamiz. Fikrlarni sanash uchun 'also', 'however', 'on the other hand', 'firstly' kabi so'zlardan ham foydalanishimiz mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Should children use the Internet? Read the points (1-6) and mark them as P (pros) or C (cons). Then, listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Bolalar Internetdan foydalanishi kerakmi? Fikrlarni (1-6) o'qing va ularni P (afzallik) yoki C (kamchilik) deb belgilang. Keyin tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 P - dunyoning qismi, kerak
  2 C - o'yin, o'rganish emas
  3 P - boshqa mamlakatlar haqida
  4 P - butun dunyo odamlari
  5 C - ba'zi saytlar mos emas
  6 P - uzoq joylardan do'stlar

  ⚠ Audio bilan tekshiring.


⚠ 'SUITABLE':

  = mos, munosib.


⚠ 'FARAWAY':

  = uzoq.


⚠ 'A CULTURE':

  = madaniyat.

items.textEn: 6 They can make friends in faraway places.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the topic sentences. Which: states the topic and main viewpoints; introduces points for; introduces points against; sums up the topic and gives an opinion?
exercises.instructionUz: Mavzu gaplarini o'qing. Qaysi biri: mavzu va asosiy nuqtai nazarlarni bayon qiladi; tarafdor fikrlarni kiritadi; qarshi fikrlarni kiritadi; mavzuni umumlashtirib fikr beradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU GAPLARI (topic sentences) -
har xatboshining birinchi gapi.

JAVOBLAR:
  states the topic → 2 ('The
    Internet is a great learning
    tool ..., but what about ...?')
  introduces points for → 3 ('Many
    people are in favour of ...')
  introduces points against → 1
    ('On the other hand, some
    people are against ...')
  sums up + opinion → 4 ('The
    Internet offers many advantages,
    but children should be
    supervised ...')


⚠ 'A TOPIC SENTENCE':

  = mavzu gapi (xatboshi mazmunini
  ochuvchi birinchi gap).


⚠ 'IN FAVOUR OF':

  = tarafdori.
  ⚠ 'against' = qarshi.


⚠ 'A LEARNING TOOL':

  = o'rganish vositasi.


⚠ 'ON THEIR OWN':

  = o'zlari, mustaqil.


⚠ 'TO SUPERVISE':

  = nazorat qilmoq.


⚠ 'PROPERLY':

  = to'g'ri, munosib.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the points for and against, and the topic sentences above, to talk about the pros and cons of the Internet for children.
exercises.instructionUz: Tarafdor va qarshi fikrlar hamda yuqoridagi mavzu gaplaridan foydalanib bolalar uchun Internetning afzallik va kamchiliklari haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Mavzu gapi + fikrlar:
  'Many people are in favour ...
   Firstly, ... Also, ...'
  'On the other hand, ... Firstly,
   ... Also, ...'
exercises.exampleEn: Many people are in favour of children using the Internet. Firstly, the net is part of our world, so children need to use it. Also, they learn about other countries and cultures.
exercises.exampleUz: Ko'p odamlar bolalarning Internetdan foydalanishi tarafdori. Birinchidan, Internet dunyomizning qismi, shuning uchun bolalar undan foydalanishi kerak. Shuningdek, ular boshqa mamlakatlar va madaniyatlar haqida o'rganadi.
modelAnswers: What is more, children can meet people from all over the world and make friends in faraway places.

On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own. Firstly, many children use it for playing games, not for learning. Also, some web sites are not suitable for children.
In conclusion, the Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised when they're using it.
modelAnswersUz: Bundan tashqari, bolalar butun dunyodan odamlarni uchratishi va uzoq joylarda do'stlar orttirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar bolalarni o'zlari Internetda kezishga qo'yishga qarshi. Birinchidan, ko'p bolalar undan o'rganish uchun emas, o'yin uchun foydalanadi. Shuningdek, ba'zi saytlar bolalar uchun mos emas.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internet ko'p afzalliklar beradi, lekin bolalar undan foydalanganda nazorat qilinishi kerak.

structure.modelEn: The Internet is a great learning tool for children, but what about the problems and dangers if children are allowed to surf the net on their own?
structure.modelUz: Internet bolalar uchun ajoyib o'rganish vositasi, lekin bolalarga o'zlari Internetda kezishga ruxsat berilsa, muammo va xavflar-chi?

structure.modelEn: Many people are in favour of children using the Internet. Firstly, the net is part of our world, so children need to learn how to use it. Also, they can learn about other countries and cultures. What is more, they can meet people from all over the world and make friends in faraway places.
structure.modelUz: Ko'p odamlar bolalarning Internetdan foydalanishi tarafdori. Birinchidan, Internet dunyomizning qismi, shuning uchun bolalar undan foydalanishni o'rganishi kerak. Shuningdek, ular boshqa mamlakatlar va madaniyatlar haqida o'rganishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ular butun dunyodan odamlarni uchratishi va uzoq joylarda do'stlar orttirishi mumkin.

structure.modelEn: On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own. Firstly, many children use the Internet for playing games, not for learning. Also, some web sites are not suitable for children, and they may see things that are not good for them.
structure.modelUz: Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar bolalarni o'zlari Internetda kezishga qo'yishga qarshi. Birinchidan, ko'p bolalar Internetdan o'rganish uchun emas, o'yin uchun foydalanadi. Shuningdek, ba'zi saytlar bolalar uchun mos emas va ular o'zlari uchun yaxshi bo'lmagan narsalarni ko'rishi mumkin.

structure.modelEn: In conclusion, the Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised when they're using it, and parents must teach them how to use it properly.
structure.modelUz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internet ko'p afzalliklar beradi, lekin bolalar undan foydalanganda nazorat qilinishi kerak, ota-onalar esa ularga to'g'ri foydalanishni o'rgatishi kerak.

modelAnswers:
The Internet is a great learning tool for children, but what about the problems and dangers if children are allowed to surf the net on their own?

Many people are in favour of children using the Internet. Firstly, the net is part of our world, so children need to learn how to use it. Also, they can learn about other countries and cultures. What is more, they can meet people from all over the world and make friends in faraway places.

On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own. Firstly, many children use the Internet for playing games, not for learning. Also, some web sites are not suitable for children, and they may see things that are not good for them.

In conclusion, the Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised when they're using it, and parents must teach them how to use it properly.
modelAnswersUz:
Internet bolalar uchun ajoyib o'rganish vositasi, lekin bolalarga o'zlari Internetda kezishga ruxsat berilsa, muammo va xavflar-chi?

Ko'p odamlar bolalarning Internetdan foydalanishi tarafdori. Birinchidan, Internet dunyomizning qismi, shuning uchun bolalar undan foydalanishni o'rganishi kerak. Shuningdek, ular boshqa mamlakatlar va madaniyatlar haqida o'rganishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ular butun dunyodan odamlarni uchratishi va uzoq joylarda do'stlar orttirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar bolalarni o'zlari Internetda kezishga qo'yishga qarshi. Birinchidan, ko'p bolalar Internetdan o'rganish uchun emas, o'yin uchun foydalanadi. Shuningdek, ba'zi saytlar bolalar uchun mos emas va ular o'zlari uchun yaxshi bo'lmagan narsalarni ko'rishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, Internet ko'p afzalliklar beradi, lekin bolalar undan foydalanganda nazorat qilinishi kerak, ota-onalar esa ularga to'g'ri foydalanishni o'rgatishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentence. What does it mean?
exercises.explanationUz:
'A LITTLE KNOWLEDGE IS A DANGEROUS
THING.'
  = Ozgina bilim - xavfli narsa.
  MA'NOSI: biror narsani chala
  bilgan odam o'zini bilimdon deb
  o'ylab, xato qilishi mumkin. To'la
  bilim yoki hech narsa.


⚠ 'KNOWLEDGE':

  = bilim. /ˈnɒlɪdʒ/ - 'k'
  o'qilmaydi!
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.

items.en: A little knowledge is a dangerous thing.
items.answerEn: If you know only a little about something, you may think you know more than you do, and make serious mistakes.
items.answerUz: Agar biror narsa haqida ozgina bilsangiz, ko'proq bilaman deb o'ylab, jiddiy xatolar qilishingiz mumkin.

patterns.formula: Many people are in favour of + OT + -ING.
patterns.exampleEn: Many people are in favour of children using the Internet.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p odamlar bolalarning Internetdan foydalanishi tarafdori.

patterns.formula: On the other hand, some people are against + -ING.
patterns.exampleEn: On the other hand, some people are against letting children surf the net on their own.
patterns.exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi odamlar bolalarni o'zlari Internetda kezishga qo'yishga qarshi.

patterns.formula: X offers many advantages, but + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: The Internet offers many advantages, but children should be supervised.
patterns.exampleUz: Internet ko'p afzalliklar beradi, lekin bolalar nazorat qilinishi kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: You are a student, aren't you? - Yes, I am.
